violated_contract: When a caller cancels an async session, teardown that issues a terminal protocol send must not block indefinitely on transport backpressure. The cancel path must bound that send and still complete cancellation of peer tasks so shutdown cannot hang.
canonical_prevention: Wrap terminal teardown sends (for example a WebSocket finalize frame) in asyncio.wait_for using the session drain timeout or a small default, treat timeout and send errors as fail-open, and cover the production cancel path with a hermetic regression that blocks the send and proves CancelledError returns within the bound while peer tasks are cancelled.
